paper.title_en: Massive quantum divergence on the Cauchy horizon of a black hole
paper.abstract_en: We investigate a quantum {\it massive} scalar field in the interior of a charged and spherically-symmetric (Reissner-Nordström) black hole. We examine the behaviour for varying values of the black hole charge, field mass and coupling constant when the field is in two quantum states: Hartle-Hawking (representing a black hole in thermal equilibrium) and Unruh (representing a black hole evaporating via the emission of Hawking radiation). We show that the vacuum polarization (in both states) generically {\it diverges} on the Cauchy horizon, in stark contrast to what happens for massless fields; also, the angular components of the quantum stress-energy tensor generically {\it diverge} on the Cauchy horizon and, in at least one of the two states, they do so more strongly than for massless fields. Furthermore, we calculate the energy fluxes in Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates $\{u,v\}$. We show that these fluxes in both states on the Cauchy horizon do not generically vanish. This implies, in particular, that in regular, Kruskal coordinates $\{U,V\}$ the ingoing flux diverges like $V^{-2}$ on the Cauchy horizon (where $V=0$). This divergence suggests that its backreaction via the semiclassical Einstein equations would yield a strong singularity, as opposed to its weaker, classical counterpart. Interestingly, there are exceptions, in which the energy fluxes in Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates vanish: (i) in the extremal limit (where the black hole is maximally charged); (ii) certain fine-tuned regions of parameter space, where the fluxes change sign.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究带电球对称黑洞内部大质量量子标量场在柯西视界上的真空极化和量子应力-能量张量行为，明确指出其与无质量场情形的显著差异，并计算Eddington-Finkelstein坐标下的能流及Kruskal坐标下的发散形式，还讨论了极端极限和精细调节参数区域的例外。选题与黑洞热力学及霍金辐射半经典背反应直接相关，理论深度较高，结论具体且有可检验的定性预言，值得点击阅读全文。
decision.title_zh: 黑洞柯西视界上的巨大量子发散
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究带电且球对称（Reissner-Nordström）黑洞内部的一个量子{\it 大质量}标量场。我们考察当该场处于两种量子态——Hartle-Hawking态（代表处于热平衡的黑洞）和Unruh态（代表通过发射Hawking辐射而蒸发的黑洞）——时，场对黑洞电荷、场质量与耦合常数不同取值的依赖行为。我们证明，（两种态下的）真空极化在柯西视界上一般会{\it 发散}，这与无质量场情形形成鲜明对比；此外，量子应力-能量张量的角向分量在柯西视界上一般也会{\it 发散}，并且在这两种态中至少有一种态下，其发散程度强于无质量场。进一步，我们在Eddington-Finkelstein坐标$\{u,v\}$下计算了能量通量。我们证明，这两种态下的这些通量在柯西视界上一般不为零。这尤其意味着，在正则的Kruskal坐标$\{U,V\}$下，入射通量在柯西视界（其中$V=0$）上按$V^{-2}$发散。这一发散表明，其通过半经典Einstein方程的背反应将产生一个强奇点，而非其较弱的经典对应物。有趣的是，存在一些例外情形，其中Eddington-Finkelstein坐标下的能量通量为零：(i) 极端极限（此时黑洞带电量最大）；(ii) 参数空间中某些精细调节的区域，在这些区域通量改变符号。
